reviews.x: I am thoroughly pleased with my electric razor. I have a very tough beard and I have been able to get a very close, and smooth shave.

[[VIDEOID:aa61a335272d2dc3bff752ea91470957]] My friend likes it very much and says it's very noisy. The beard can be scraped very clean. There are a lot of accessories, and it even has an instrument for cleaning nose hair.
This electric razor is very good. I have been using Gillette for many years manually and this is my first electric razor. I gotta admit, it's a much better experience than I expected.

Never have this before.this is awesome. Because it has everything I need. Now I don't have to worry anymore. 1 of this clean up every thing. I don't need to buy any other ones. All in 1. Good work. Love it

The five in one function is so cool and that is my chose it from so many other products. It didn’t take me down. The shaver makes it so easy to shave the curve of face and neck. And nose trimmer works effectively. It is water proof which makes it so easy to clean up.

This item has great attachments. The shaver part work so great,It takes a bit to get used to the capabilities of the attachments, I love how quickly you can change all of the attachments out. I can hit the beard, head, nose, ears in one shot. Then give it all a quick rinse and its nice and clean. It cuts effortlessly and is very quiet.but I can keep my hair properly trimmed (since I like it short anyway) and my beard and mustache look fabulous with this device. Highly recommend this for grooming

I purchased this razor (my 4th in a quest for a good electric) because of the 39 5 star reviews. I don't know what they got, but this was not a 5 star razor. I have a fairly heavy beard and this razor dragged worse than any other.  They need to get the rpm's up I had charged it for 24 hrs when I got it. Tried it for a few days and just not satisfied/never tried attachments/ returned it Went back to my Norelco for now

I purchased a trimmer and this shaver so I could get a close shave with this and keep trimmed up with the other on, the one I purchased for trimming gives me a better shave on zero than this does after having to spend way more time re-shaving my face with this thing 3 or times to get all the missed hairs or stubble. Feels and operates very cheaply made feeling.

Feels,sounds, and works like a toy. I gave my face time to adapt to this razor. After I am done it still looks like I have a 5 o clock shadow after spending twice the time shaving. I am buying a brand name model now.  Does not even come with a plug, just a USB cord. Waste of money.

reviews.t: Won't Compete with Norelco Triple it's Styled Like
reviews.x: UPDATE: This does get a little better with use, or I got a little more used to using it, or a little of both. My Norelco is a little old and needs a new switch. I use the Rozia most of the time now when I shave. I dump the whiskers out every time I shave. The assembly that mounts the shaving heads will come loose from the driving assembly that is the lower half of the shaving head replacement part. It then has to be reconnected to the little metal hinge and latched. That's slightly difficult to

reviews.t: We'll see how long this lasts...
reviews.x: Provides a decent shave, particularly after the beard has been moistened as it is immediately after a shower.  The question is, for how long, considering the flimsy construction of some components and the already below-specified battery life.  Things they don't describe in the mostly worthless manual:  The charging indicator is a steady red AC plug symbol.  The LCD indication at full charge is 99.  A RED (not a far more intuitive GREEN) battery full symbol is shown at when the charge reaches 99.

I bought it mainly for the nasal hair trimmer and it works very well. No more fumbling with a pair of sharp scissors inside my nose! The shaver also works smoothly. I haven't tried the other three functions, but just the nasal hair trimmer and the shaver are well worth the price.

I absolutely love this razor. I purchased this one and after about a month and a half the area where the different heads attach the little connecter that makes it run broke. So my mother-in-law purchased me another one to replace it and it did the exact same thing. So she got me another one making it 3 in total. I am mentally handicapped but I am very gentle when switching out the different attachments parts. I would get a fourth one but I am afraid that it will happen again. I am very pleased o

Nice shaver that tells you how much charge is left. Easy to use, but disappointed in the lack of a close shave. I may have a bad unit, but wouldn't buy again as I have to re-shave over the same spots to get close enough.  After using this shaver for several months, it is quite under-powered. The battery does not last very long, but unfortunately it is under-powered in most cases. Again, I could just have a bad unit.  Update - It is now the end of April, having bot this item in December, the batt

reviews.t: Liked it... but razor just stopped working completely after a few months
reviews.x: Title. I really enjoyed it while it worked; however, after a few months of use (and keeping it clean), the razor decided to run continuously and not turn off. I thought maybe it had gotten wet, but I keep it clean and put it away after every use. It was essentially stuck in the on position and never turned off until the batteries ran out. I checked to make sure the button wasn't stuck but it wasn't. I would like to get a refund or possibly trade it in, but i'm not sure how to contact the seller.

reviews.t: Good idea. Poor quality control. Only lasted one week
reviews.x: I have yet to find a multi-purpose electric shaver that has a decent rotatory shaver until I came across this one. I thought I have found "the one" I could travel with. For one week, it worked great! Then it just stopped working after one charge. With its low price point, I did not expect it to last long but I did expect it to last more than ONE WEEK. I didn't realize i was buying a disposable shaver. You get what you paid for, I guess. I do not recommend this product based on the poor quality c

I thought it would be a "good deal" but was immediately suspicious at how light the product felt. It felt too light and rather cheap. At first I thought this might be a good thing until I noticed that the thing barely held a charge. The charge indicator fell from the max of 99 to 75 within 15-20 minutes. If the charge falls below a certain point then it doesn't even cut well. I returned it to get a better quality product...(which I have not gotten yet but will probably be) like Braun or similar.

reviews.t: Good shaver for its price tag
reviews.x: I was struggling to find good electric shaver for my husband cause his last one didn’t last a year and the battery died. Then I stumbled across this one, and decided to give it a try. My husband loves it! He said that he loves that it is easy to clean, just pop it open on the top and use the brush to get hair out. He also likes the varieties of top comes with including nasal hair shaver and side of hair saver, etc. he said that the hand grip is steady and quality is decent with its price.

I liked this product before it was broken in near nine months. I have used shaver, as well as face blush and nose trimmer. It suddenly drops the battery level from 99% to 0% in less than 10 seconds. It continues to happen after that. So, I can't do anything in those less than 10 seconds. The previous shaver, made by Phillips, lasted more than 10 years, so I will not buy the shaver from this maker again. I will give a similar product from other makers a shot.

Be very careful. I have ruined 2 now by accidently using the wrong cord. If you're like me and tend to  keep extra cords around "just in case", make sure you remove all of them from the area. And, of course, i did this after the return time was up.  As far as operating it, it's def one of the better ones I've bought. However, I only used it a limited time. Cleaning is easy. A lot of them will come apart when you try this, but this is did not.

Just got the razor today and tried it out.  Seems to shave pretty well.  I have a basket under my sink of 3-4 completely good razors that just don't shave well.  A couple of foils as well as some rotarys.  I find the dual action rotary works the best which this has.  Giving it only 2 stars since it does not come with a charging brick.  Was unable to see one in any customer pictures, although the customer pictures are not very useful.

reviews.t: Has trouble going through long hair
reviews.x: Tried to use this to take off my winter growth and then shave my head. Would not trim with the bare blade after the first 'row'. Finally had to use another trimmer.  Shaving went as expected based on other reviews, better with a wet head. Beard trimming was first, and went well enough. Battery life seemed to drop rather quickly during use. Hard to tell how badly, as I had to switch tools. Nose hair trimmer worked quite well.

reviews.t: Not worth the price dead at 7 months
reviews.x: The motor on mine died today. I just checked and it has a 90 day warranty. The razor stopped working at 7months. I'm sorry I didnt check because I would not of bought this razor. Its been weak since da one and pulls hair while shaving. I is cosmetically great. looks expensive has many accessories but if the motor quits it just a paper weight with many accessories

reviews.t: Didn't work right off the bat
reviews.x: I purchased this as an upgrade for my last clippers (which no longer function). On first use, the clippers not only didn't shave, but yanked some hair right out of my head. I can't say whether the other attachments were functional, as I bought this specifically for shaving my head. Returning, and ordering my previous brand of clippers!

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the close, smooth shave they get, even with tough beards.
The multi-function design with many attachments (including a nose trimmer) is a commonly appreciated feature.
Several reviewers report poor shave performance, needing to re-shave repeatedly and still not getting close.
Durability and build quality are concerns, with reports of flimsy construction and units breaking or failing after a few months.
Some reviewers find the razor underpowered or dragging, especially on heavier beards.
